'''Denvas Ran''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] merchant who resided on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Denvas Ran appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as Companion Customization Importer vendor on the Imperial fleet.
